definitions.meaning: lịch trình du lịch, kế hoạch chuyến đi

examples: She planned a detailed itinerary for their two-week trip.
The tour guide handed out the itinerary on the first day.
Make sure your passport is valid for at least six months before you travel.
She lost her passport at the airport and had to contact the embassy.
You need to show your boarding pass at the gate before you can board the plane.
He downloaded his boarding pass on his phone to avoid printing it.
The airline only allows one piece of carry-on luggage per passenger.
She struggled to lift her heavy luggage onto the overhead rack.

definitions.meaning: thủ tục nhận phòng hoặc đăng ký tại sân bay
làm thủ tục nhận phòng, đăng ký

examples: Online check-in opens 24 hours before the flight departure.
We arrived at the hotel early but check-in was not until 3 p.m.
The travel package includes flights and accommodation for seven nights.
They had trouble finding affordable accommodation during the peak season.
I made a reservation at the restaurant for eight o'clock.
You should confirm your hotel reservation a few days before arrival.
The departure lounge was crowded with passengers waiting for their flights.
Our departure time is 6:30 a.m., so we need to be at the airport by 4:30.
The arrivals board showed that the flight from London was on time.
Upon arrival, guests should head to the reception desk to get their room key.

definitions.meaning: việc tham quan, ngắm cảnh du lịch

examples: We spent the morning sightseeing around the old town.
A hop-on hop-off bus is a great way to do sightseeing in a new city.

definitions.meaning: điểm tham quan, điểm thu hút du khách

examples: The Eiffel Tower is one of the most visited tourist attractions in the world.
The city has many free attractions that families can enjoy.

definitions.meaning: quà lưu niệm, đồ kỷ niệm

examples: She bought a small souvenir from every country she visited.
The souvenir shop near the museum sold postcards and fridge magnets.
He bought a guidebook before the trip so he could learn about the local culture.
The guidebook recommended several hidden gems that most tourists miss.
The tour guide explained the history of each monument as they walked through the city.
A knowledgeable tour guide can make a big difference to your travel experience.

definitions.meaning: tiền tệ, đơn vị tiền tệ

examples: You should exchange your currency before you leave for a foreign country.
The local currency is the euro, and most shops do not accept US dollars.
Always check the exchange rate before converting your money at the airport.
The exchange rate today is more favourable than it was last week.
Citizens of some countries need a visa to enter Japan.
She applied for a tourist visa three weeks before her trip.
He had to declare all the gifts he was carrying when going through customs.
The customs officer asked to inspect her luggage at the border.

definitions.meaning: thời gian dừng chờ chuyển chuyến bay

examples: We had a four-hour layover in Dubai before our connecting flight.
She used her layover to explore the airport's duty-free shops.
They spent a week at a beach resort in Thailand.
The ski resort offers lessons for beginners and advanced slopes for experts.

definitions.meaning: người du lịch ba lô, người đi phượt

examples: Southeast Asia is very popular with backpackers because of its low costs.
As a backpacker, she stayed in hostels and cooked her own meals to save money.

definitions.meaning: mệt mỏi do lệch múi giờ (jet lag)

examples: After the long flight from New York, she suffered from jet lag for several days.
Drinking plenty of water during the flight can help reduce jet lag.

definitions.meaning: ẩm thực địa phương, món ăn bản địa

examples: Trying the local cuisine is one of the best parts of travelling to a new country.
The tour included a cooking class where visitors learned to prepare local cuisine.
A round trip ticket to Paris costs less if you book two months in advance.
She booked a round trip so she could return home after the conference.
Always buy travel insurance in case your flight is cancelled or you fall ill abroad.
His travel insurance covered the cost of the hospital visit during his trip.
